item.title: The Winter Olympics opening ceremony: A fusion of artistry and athleticism
item.description: While the snowy South Bend weather continues piling up and the scarves are nowhere near being put away, we all need a winter romanticization. The Winter Olympics are now here to bring us comfort amid the chaos and to remind us that community and culture still stand with positive human achievement. item.title: Saint Marys softball prepares for upcoming spring season
item.description: The Saint Mary's softball team is back in full swing under head coach Jordyn Walter, who last season took over for co-head coaches Cassie and Jamie Young. Last season, Walter led the team to a 10-20 season and finished eighth in the MIAA with a 4-12 conference record. item.title: In defense of performative studying
item.description: "Performative studying," the act of studying excessively in public to appear studious and hardworking to your peers, seems like an oxymoron. How could something that used to be "nerdy" and uncool be performative? Who would want to be perceived as someone who's always studying?But as most people at Notre Dame can attest, here the person who studies the least usually doesn't want people to know about it.
